title: ONE 10 KT NUKE
BESIDE A US CARRIER
yt_title: What One Nuke Would Do to a US Carrier Group #shorts
hook: A nuclear weapon bursts beside a US carrier group at night, and twelve minutes is all the warning there is.

title: ONE 10 KT NUKE

yt_title: What One Nuke Would Do to a US Navy Escort at Sea #shorts

title: ONE 10 KT NUKE
2.5 KM FROM A CARRIER
